note: The National Bank of Cambodia's Prakas B7-020-352 on Credit Reporting (26 June 2020), article 12, as DFDL's legal update summarises it: negative credit information is disseminated three years from the maturity date. Registered as secondary, the prakas itself not read. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: DFDL, Cambodia Monthly Legal Update, July 2020
sources.said: Pursuant to Article 12, a CRSP will retain the information for 15 years and disseminate the information within the following periods: ... 3 years from the maturity date in case of negative credit information;
